newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan highway company 1996 turnover up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan highway company 1996 turnover up 20 pct.

text.p: Morocco's highway construction firm Societe Nationale des Autoroutes (ADM) had turnover of 140 million dirhams ($14.3 million) in 1996, up 20 percent from the previous year, the public works ministry said on Wednesday.

It said in a statement carried by the official news agency MAP that the company had a deficit of 65 million dirhams as a result of financial costs connected to loans while gross operating surplus totalled 62 million dirhams. It gave no comparative figures.
Members of the board said they were looking into raising the capital to 780 million dirhams from 219.5 million dirhams.
